definitions.explanation: Pain or hardship, or the trouble it gives one's mind. Used mostly in set phrases ({苦|く}にする, {苦|く}もなく) and as the first element of compounds; on its own it is written-language.

examples.english: He solved the problem without any trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{苦|く}にして⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: She worried over her mistake and couldn't sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なこと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧なら{苦|く}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Getting up early every morning is no hardship when it is for something I love.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{苦|く}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to worry about, to take to heart
- {苦|く}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be no trouble at all
- {苦|く}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: with ease, effortlessly
- ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{苦|く}あり: life has its ups and downs (proverb)
- ⟦{苦|く}{楽|らく}→苦楽：05566_kuraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共|とも}にする→共にする：18718_tomonisuru⟧: to share joys and sorrows

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧: hardship, trouble — the everyday noun
- ⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧: pain, distress — physical or mental
